    JRO Enchanter¶

    In the Database

    Every item this enchanter works on, the enchants it adds and the NPC on the map: open its Database entry. Item pages link back here too.

    Location: moc_para01 42, 38 · Quest Room
    Enchant cost 2× Enchant Ticket #1000874 + 10,000,000 Zeny
    Reset cost 5× Enchant Ticket #1000874 + 5,000,000 Zeny

    The JRO Enchanter adds the Japanese server's special enchants to headgear, armor, weapons, shields, garments, shoes and accessories. It replaces the old Aulion and Desmond enchanters.

    • Slots are filled in order: slot 4 first, then slot 3, then slot 2. Each try fills the next empty slot with one random enchant from that slot's list. Every enchant in a list has the same chance.
    • Some slots need the item to be refined first. The Refine column shows the lowest refine for that slot.
    • Slots that are card slots of the item (for example slot 2 of a weapon with 2 card slots) are never enchanted.
    • Reset removes every enchant (cards stay) so you can start again. Refine, grade and random options are kept.
    • Rental items, signed or forged items and equipped items can't be enchanted. Take the item off first.
